name: cost-lens
description: See where Claude Code tokens and dollars go, catch cold-cache rebuilds, and pick cheaper models.

llmFeatures.title: Allow LLM features
llmFeatures.description: Let a small Claude model (Haiku) read the text of each prompt you type, to recommend the model that fits it. Off: cost-lens sends none of your data to a model.

recommendationAlerts.title: Model recommendation notifications
recommendationAlerts.description: Show a notification when the model that fits a prompt differs from the one in use, at most every 10 minutes. Needs LLM features.
